matches: Both are impact-landform study areas; crater-related relief supports slope and approach-planning experiments.
differences: Meteor includes a bowl/ejecta neighbourhood, while this Shackleton crop samples a rim.

explanation.scope: Literature-informed comparison hypothesis plus regional terrain descriptors; not independently validated geological equivalence, engineering transfer or landing suitability.

accuracy_check.accuracy_reason: No independent ground-truth matched-landform benchmark or site-specific DEM error model. Similarity is not accuracy.

analysis.caveat: Very small regional sample; roughness includes slope. Equal grid spacing does not equal native resolving power. Absolute elevation is not compared across different vertical datums.

window_sensitivity.reason: 25 independent combinations of five window positions. A span over 0.10 flags sensitivity by an engineering rule; this is not a confidence interval or an accuracy estimate.
